newsitem.title: USA: Five found dead in home on Detroit's west side.
newsitem.headline: Five found dead in home on Detroit's west side.

text.p: A woman and four small children were found dead in a home on Detroit's west side early Wednesday in a grisly murder scene that veteran police officials described as one of the worst they had ever seen.
The victims were discovered by the dead woman's sister, who is also the mother of two of the dead children. Police would not say how the victims died, but broadcast reports said they were stabbed.
"It's probably the most disturbing thing I've ever seen, personally," Benny Napoleon, executive deputy police chief, told reporters.

Police identified the dead woman as 21-year-old Yolanda Bellamy. Also killed were her children, Nathan Burns Jr., 5; Nathan Burns III, 3; and her nephew and niece, Delvontay Bellamy, 5, and three-year-old Shafontah Bellamy.
Police said they were questioning a male friend of Yolanda Bellamy, but said he was not considered a suspect. They also want to question other people in their investigation.
